MIST_EQUIP.WornEmpty: Nothing worn. Equip weapons and armor, put on clothing and a backpack, or drag wearable things here.
MIST_EQUIP.AtHandEmpty: Nothing at hand. Drag items here to take them out of a container.
MIST_EQUIP.ContainerEmpty: Empty. Drag items here to put them inside.
MIST_EQUIP.CannotHold: A container cannot go inside itself or into what it holds.
MIST_EQUIP.WearableHint: Put on like armor (clothing, a backpack): its row gets a wear button, and it can be dragged onto Worn. Worn, it takes no slots; its capacity bonus counts only while it is worn.
MIST_EQUIP.ContainerHint: Holds other items (a backpack, a bag): the inventory gets a section for it, and items dragged onto it go inside.
MIST_EQUIP.UnpackFailed: Could not take the items out of {name} on {actor}; they stay packed inside it. See the console (F12).
MIST_EQUIP.ArmorSlotsHint: Armor slots marked: {used} of {max}. They stay marked on the armor when it is taken off or passed on.
MIST_EQUIP.DurabilityEnableHint: Switches durability on for this item; it starts full. Players see it, and the owner can lower and raise it here.
MIST_EQUIP.BrokenHint: Broken: durability 0 of {max}. It still works; the GM decides what that means.
MIST_EQUIP.SettingDurabilityHint: Durability on weapons, armor and loot. Off, it is hidden everywhere and cannot be changed; the numbers stay on the items and come back when it is switched on again.
MIST_EQUIP.UnidentifiedEnableHint: Until the GM identifies it, the item goes by the name and picture below, for everyone, the GM too, without its description, features or tags, and its effects do not work. Players cannot open, equip, put on or use it. The real item is shown here.
MIST_EQUIP.MysteryNameHint: What players call the item until it is identified, such as Strange ring. Empty: Unidentified item.
MIST_EQUIP.MysteryImgHint: The picture players see until the item is identified. Empty: a stone with a question mark.
MIST_EQUIP.UnidentifiedDescription: You have not studied this item yet. Only the GM can reveal what it is.
MIST_EQUIP.UnidentifiedHint: Not identified yet: the GM must study it before it can be equipped or used.
MIST_EQUIP.UnidentifiedGMHint: Unidentified: it is really {name}. Players cannot open, equip or use it. Click to identify.
MIST_EQUIP.CannotEquipUnidentified: {name} is not identified yet: the GM must identify it before it can be equipped.
MIST_EQUIP.CannotUseUnidentified: {name} is not identified yet: it cannot be used until the GM identifies it.
MIST_EQUIP.UsableUnidentifiedEnableHint: A player may use it without knowing what it is, such as drinking a potion of unknown effect. Using it identifies it: its name, description and effects come back, and it works. On by default for consumables.
MIST_EQUIP.UsableUnidentifiedHint: Not identified yet: you can use it without knowing what it does, and then you will learn what it was.
